title: StatutoryFeeCaps
description: Authoritative, effective-dated core table of statutory CFA and DBA fee arrangement maximums and defined calculation bases (ADR 0034 / S0-28b).

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the statutory fee caps data schema

rows.description: Effective-dated statutory CFA and DBA maximum percentage rows, each pairing a category, maximum percentage, and mandatory calculation base.

rowId.description: Stable unique identifier for this effective-dated statutory fee cap row

capCategoryKey.description: Canonical statutory cap category key referenced by work-type configuration and fee arrangements

feeBasis.description: Fee arrangement basis governed by this row

caseTypeLabel.description: Human-readable case type category label (British English)

maxPercent.description: Statutory maximum percentage permitted for this category and effective period

capBaseKey.description: Canonical machine key for the monetary base against which maxPercent is measured

capBaseDescription.description: Authoritative human-readable calculation base description stored alongside every percentage

effectiveFrom.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD start date from which this statutory row applies

effectiveTo.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD end date, or null while this statutory row remains in force

legislationRef.description: Statutory instrument or primary legislation reference supporting this row
